title: Getting Started with Express.js
author: John Das
description: A beginner-friendly guide to creating a backend server using Express.js.
content: Express.js is one of the most popular web frameworks for Node.js.It helps developers build web applications and REST APIs quickly and efficiently.In this project, I created an Express server with GET and POST  routes. The GET route serves the HTML pages, while the POST route receives the blog form data submitted by the user.

title: IIT Madras WSAI Launches One-Week AI Startup Course with ₹4 Lakh
author: Education Desk
description: IIT Madras launches a one-week AI startup course offering practical training, expert mentorship, investor pitching, and a ₹4 lakh grant.
content: IIT Madras WSAI has introduced a one-week AI startup programme for students, researchers, and entrepreneurs. The course covers product development, market validation, fundraising, customer discovery, and business growth through workshops and case studies.

title: Apple Launces Back to School Offer: Free Airpods with Mac
author: MC Tech Desk
description: Apple's Back to School offer gives eligible students and educators free airpods with select Mac purchases, along with education discounts.
content: Apple has launched its Back to School offer in india, running from July 16 to August 27,2026. Eligible students,educators and parents can get free AirPods when purchasing select MacBook Air through Apple's Education Store.

title: How AI is Changing the Future of Computing
author: Tech Desk
description: Aftificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming software, automation and everyday digital experiences across industries.
content: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of computing by enabling machines to perform tasks that once required human intelligence.

title: Tatanagar to Get Two New Sleeper Vande Bharat Trains
author: News Desk
description: Two new sleeper Vande Bharat trains will improve long-distance travel between Tatanagar, Mumbai, and Varanasi.
content: Indian Railways is to be introduce two new Sleeper Vande Bharat Express trains connecting Tatanagar with major cities like Mumbai and Varanasi.

title: India return to Harare with more to prove than gain
author: Crickbuzz Staff
description: India begin another T20I tour of Zimbabwe just days after concluding their UK tour With a fresh squad and young players.
content: The cricket calendar leaves little room for rest as India travel to Harare for another T20I series shortly after completing their tour of the United Kingdom.
